categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches CI configuration and workflow files on the 30.x branch to optimize runner selection and caching.
categories.rationale: Backports CI pipeline optimizations to eliminate runner selection bottlenecks and replace slow or winding-down caches. Commit 4eaccf2d74 notes that builds are 'sometimes backlogged on waiting for runner selection' and inlining selection avoids serializing all CI jobs.
